title: Boss Challenge: Mystery Slides
summary: Six unlabelled microscope slides. Focus, choose the right magnification, and identify each one.

ib.note: Unit summative-style task: microscope skills and identification (Criteria A and C)

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 2: The Invisible Living World: Beyond Our Naked Eye
Earlier NCERT Ch 8: Cell: Structure and Functions

objectives: I can use a microscope to find and focus on cells.
I can identify cells using features such as walls, chloroplasts, nuclei and shape.
misconceptions: You can identify any cell at low magnification.
